structure.unit: Organization, Admission and Licensing of Insurers
Conversion of Domestic Stock Insurer to Mutual Insurer

law.catch_line: Notice to policyholders of meeting to approve conversion
law.text: At least thirty days before the meeting of policyholders required by § 38.2-1006, the insurer shall mail notice of the meeting to each policyholder at the last known address or shall deliver the notice in person to the policyholder.
